id.description: Unique identifier for the monitor changes.

referenceKey.description: Reference key associated with the entity.

monitorId.description: Unique identifier associated with a monitor.

detected.description: Date and time when the changes were detected at the source.

created.description: Timestamp indicating when the monitor changes were created in our system.

changes.description: List of changes associated with the monitor.

source.description: Name of the source that produced this batch of changes.

profile.description: Represents the profile associated with a specific change entry.

attribute.description: Represents the specific attribute of a change entry.

action.description:
This property is used to describe the operation associated with the change, such as addition,
update, or deletion of specific data.

new.description: This property provides information about the updated or newly assigned value after a change has occurred.

old.description:
This property captures the information prior to the modification, providing
a means to track and compare historical data.
